sources.title: Central Bank of Cyprus, Bank holidays to be observed in Cyprus during 2026
sources.said: 1. Every Sunday 2. Every Saturday for bank transactions 3. Thursday, 1 January New Year’s Day 4. Tuesday, 6 January Epiphany Day 5. Monday, 23 February Green Monday 6. Wednesday, 25 March Greek Independence Day 7. Wednesday, 1 April Cyprus National Day 8. Friday, 10 April Good Friday (Greek Orthodox Church) 9. Monday, 13 April Easter Monday 10. Tuesday, 14 April Easter Tuesday 11. Friday, 1 May Labour Day 12. Monday, 1 June Pentecost 13. Thursday, 1 October Cyprus Independence Day 14. Wednesday, 28 October Greek National Day 15. Friday, 25 December Christmas Day. Note: The 15th of August, Assumption Day, falls on a Saturday; The 26th of December, Boxing Day, falls on a Saturday. (Easter Tuesday is the banks' own.)

sources.title: Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission, Public Holidays
sources.said: 06 Jan. 2026 Theophania (Epiphany); 23 Feb. 2026 Green Monday; 25 Mar. 2026 National Holiday; 01 Apr. 2026 Cyprus National Anniversary; 10 Apr. 2026 Good Friday (Greek Orthodox Church); 13 Apr. 2026 Easter Monday; 01 May. 2026 Labour Day; 01 Jun. 2026 Whit Monday; 15 Aug. 2026 Assumption Day; 01 Oct. 2026 Independence Day; 28 Oct. 2026 National Holiday; 24 Dec. 2026 Christmas Eve; 25 Dec. 2026 Christmas; 26 Dec. 2026 Boxing Day; 01 Jan. 2027 New Year's Day. (Christmas Eve is the public service's own.)
